# cpanel_mysql_remote_hosts (Data Source)

Reads the complete cPanel remote MySQL host inventory through `MysqlFE::listhosts`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_mysql_remote_hosts" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `hosts` (List of String) The normalized remote MySQL hosts in sorted order.
